content.json:
## Junction check posture
Results pushed by `junction check run --push-sentinel` to `JunctionCheck_CL`. Scores are 0 to 100; unknown and not-applicable checks are not scored.

parameters.name: Tenant
parameters.query:
JunctionCheck_CL
| summarize by EntraTenantId, Label = iff(isempty(TenantLabel), EntraTenantId, TenantLabel)
| project value = EntraTenantId, label = Label

content.query:
JunctionCheck_CL
| where '*' in ({Tenant}) or EntraTenantId in ({Tenant})
| where isnotnull(Score)
| summarize Score = take_any(Score) by RunId, TimeGenerated, Tenant = iff(isempty(TenantLabel), EntraTenantId, TenantLabel)
| project TimeGenerated, Tenant, Score
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Score over time by tenant

content.query:
let latest = JunctionCheck_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by EntraTenantId
| project EntraTenantId, RunId;
JunctionCheck_CL
| join kind=inner latest on EntraTenantId, RunId
| where '*' in ({Tenant}) or EntraTenantId in ({Tenant})
| where Status == "fail"
| summarize Failing = count() by Tenant = iff(isempty(TenantLabel), EntraTenantId, TenantLabel), Severity
| order by Failing desc
content.title: Failing checks by tenant (latest run)

content.query:
let latest = JunctionCheck_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by EntraTenantId
| project EntraTenantId, RunId;
JunctionCheck_CL
| join kind=inner latest on EntraTenantId, RunId
| where '*' in ({Tenant}) or EntraTenantId in ({Tenant})
| extend SeverityRank = case(Severity == "critical", 4, Severity == "high", 3, Severity == "medium", 2, Severity == "low", 1, 0)
| extend StatusRank = case(Status == "failed", 0, Status == "fail", 1, Status == "warn", 2, Status == "unknown", 3, Status == "not_applicable", 4, 5)
| order by StatusRank asc, SeverityRank desc, CheckId asc
| project Tenant = iff(isempty(TenantLabel), EntraTenantId, TenantLabel), CheckId, Pack, Status, Severity, Score, PackScore, Attested, Tags, Summary, RunId, TimeGenerated
content.title: Latest status per tenant and check
